notes: The marginal Hebrew gloss on after was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The Hebrew coordinates בָּזָה and לָעֲגָה asyndetically, so the ASV's and is added (rule 14's closing sentences); the two dative לְ's are unrepresented and their suffixes take thee (rule 40).
רֹאשׁ carries no suffix, so the supplied her is added (rule 18's closing sentence).
